stem: A canopy appears visually flat, but mapped PPFD varies substantially across the production area. What is the strongest conclusion?
choices: The canopy is uniform because plant height is uniform
Visual height does not prove light uniformity; evaluate measured distribution together with fixture, spacing, and canopy context
Ignore PPFD because appearance is more reliable
rationale: Canopy appearance and measured light distribution are related but not interchangeable. Technician II should use measured evidence to evaluate whether the production objective was achieved.
